notes_for_editor: Two lists only: the TN Landforms list (name, historical label, county, coordinates, elevation) and the Forest Lookouts directory (name and county, no agency or history). The directory layout is jumbled. Its 1956 'International-Stacey' 99-foot tower line follows the MILLER COUNTY entry and belongs to Miller County, not Milford; one search summary attached it to Milford, and it is not used here. No managing agency is named for Milford in any source found. Status and access stay unknown; the 'historical' label is the list's only word on its state. Not a correction to the brief, which matches the TN Landforms entry.
